text: This report summarizes the program items at the Community Liaison Consultation meeting held on March 24, 2022, and the comments and input provided by community members at that meeting. Hosting the meeting was Board Member Peter Leon. Exhibition Place staff in attendance included Judy Mahoney, Director, Sales and Marketing; Tony Porter, Director, Transportation and Security; Gilles Bouchard, Director, Event Management Services; Debbie Sanderson, Executive Assistant to the CEO; Nigel Fernandes, IT Systems; Catherine de Nobriga, Tenant and Community Relations Coordinator; and Kelvin Seow, Chief People and Strategy Officer. Representatives from Optimus SBR, the Board consultant conducted the second round of engagement sessions as part of the Strategic Plan development.
